description: This Java source file contains the EnumToString class, which generates C++ header and source files for enum-to-string conversion. It reads enum definitions from a specified header file, processes them into switch-case functions, and produces corresponding .cpp and .h files to facilitate enum string conversions in C++ projects.

classes.name: EnumToString
classes.description: A utility class that reads enum definitions from a header file and generates C++ code for enum to string conversions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command line arguments, initializes code generation, and orchestrates reading input files and writing output files.

methods.name: writeCppAndHeaderFiles
methods.description: Writes the generated C++ source and header contents to specified output files.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Reads an enum header file, parses enum definitions, and generates corresponding C++ switch-case code for enum to string conversion.

methods.name: removeSpaces
methods.description: Removes all whitespace from a line.

methods.description: Determines if a line contains an enum key-value pair.

methods.name: makeCode
methods.description: Creates C++ switch-case code for a specific enum, mapping enum values to their string representations.
